ChatEvent.description: Every SSE `data:` payload on the chat stream is one of these.
ChatEvent.title: ChatEvent

ChatRunRequest.description:
Send one user message. Model, reasoning, prompt caching and the context cap may change
from message to message.
ChatRunRequest.title: ChatRunRequest

ContextCompactedEvent.description:
Sent before the reply when the prompt neared the conversation's context cap and older
messages were folded into its summary. Token counts are estimates. `summary` describes
the change in words (it is not the summary itself); the reply keeps it as a note.
ContextCompactedEvent.title: ContextCompactedEvent

ConversationCreate.description: Start an empty conversation. Its first message gives it a title.
ConversationCreate.title: ConversationCreate

ConversationUpdate.description: Turning `save_to_memory` off forgets the facts this conversation added.
ConversationUpdate.title: ConversationUpdate

InputSection.description:
One piece of what a Claude call sent: the system prompt, a tool definition, or a
block of a message. `tokens` is an estimate: the call's real input tokens, shared out
by each section's size. The cache is a prefix, so the first `cacheReadTokens` of the
call were read from the cache and the next `cacheWriteTokens` were written to it; each
section's two cache fields are its share of those, estimated the same way.
InputSection.title: InputSection

MemoryUpdatedEvent.description:
Sent before the reply on a conversation's first message, when earlier conversations
were turned into facts. Counts are fact changes across all of them. `summary` says the
same in words; the reply keeps it as its first note.
MemoryUpdatedEvent.title: MemoryUpdatedEvent

ModelCall.description: One request to Claude while replying, by the orchestrator or a specialist agent.

billedInputTokens.description:
The input as if every token were charged at the normal input price: cache reads
count for a fraction of a token, cache writes for 1.25.
billedInputTokens.title: Billedinputtokens

costUsd.description: Estimated US dollars for this call. None for a model without known prices.
costUsd.title: Costusd

costWithoutCacheUsd.description: What the same call would have cost with every input token at full price.
costWithoutCacheUsd.title: Costwithoutcacheusd

ModelCall.title: ModelCall

TextPart.description:
A stretch of Claude's thinking, answer text, or a progress note (text written just
before a tool call).
TextPart.title: TextPart

ThinkingDeltaEvent.description:
A piece of Claude's summarized reasoning. It can arrive before the text and again
between pieces of text, around tool calls.
ThinkingDeltaEvent.title: ThinkingDeltaEvent

ToolPart.description: A tool Claude called while replying.
ToolPart.title: ToolPart

Usage.description:
Tokens spent on one message, sub-agents included. `input_tokens` excludes cached
input, which is counted in the two cache fields.
Usage.title: Usage

post.description: Exchange a Google authorization code for an app session cookie.

Save the user's message and stream Claude's reply.

Auth, validation and unknown-conversation errors happen before streaming starts and
return normal Problem Details. After the 200, failures arrive as a run_failed event.

200.description: SSE stream; each data payload is a ChatEvent
